import Mathlib
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Axler_exercise_1_8 {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] {ι : Type*} (u : ι → Submodule F V) :
  ∃ U : Submodule F V, (⋂ (i : ι), (u i).carrier) = ↑U := by
  let U : Submodule F V :=
    { carrier := ⋂ (i : ι), (u i).carrier
      add_mem' := by
        intro a b ha hb
        simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at ha hb ⊢
        intro i
        exact (u i).add_mem (ha i) (hb i)
      zero_mem' := by
        simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
        intro i
        exact (u i).zero_mem
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c x hx
        simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hx ⊢
        intro i
        exact (u i).smul_mem c (hx i) }
  exact ⟨U, rfl⟩
